marks.label: Somalia Humanitarian Fund allocation announced, 12 Oct
Second Juba gauge over its own 1-in-3 level, 25 Oct
Second Shabelle gauge over its own 1-in-3 level, 6 Nov

notes.2023-10-03: Highest forecast in the activation band: Juba 71% of its threshold, Shabelle 69%.
notes.2023-10-07: Highest forecast in the activation band: Juba 89% of its threshold, Shabelle 65%.
notes.2023-10-10: The last archived issue before the Somalia Humanitarian Fund allocation was announced on 12 Oct. Highest forecast in the activation band: Juba 93% of its threshold, Shabelle 60%.
notes.2023-10-14: Highest forecast in the activation band: Juba 83% of its threshold, Shabelle 55%.
notes.2023-10-17: Highest forecast in the activation band: Juba 95% of its threshold, Shabelle 52%.
notes.2023-10-21: First issue on which the readiness trigger is reached: Juba, 4 of 4 stations. First issue on which the activation trigger is reached: Juba, 4 of 4 stations. The issue before it is 17 Oct, so on daily forecasts the first day would fall from 18 Oct to 21 Oct.
notes.2023-10-28: Observed on 25 Oct: the second Juba gauge reached its own 1-in-3 level.
notes.2023-11-07: Observed on 6 Nov: the second Shabelle gauge reached its own 1-in-3 level.
